title: The source kernel and image of finite scalar local models are derived complete
statement:
The source kernel and image of finite scalar local models are derived complete. The precise assertion, including all universes and canonical-unit conditions, is:

theorem supported_kernel_image_base_complete
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (L M : AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) (f : L ⟶ M)
    (hL : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X L)
    (hM : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X M) :
    IsDerivedComplete l E X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (kernel f)) ∧
    IsDerivedComplete l E X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (image f))

Definitions and statement dependencies: [sk-def-sfb-constructible] [sk-def-pe-derived-completion].

source.place: Lemma 3.4.12, Lemma 3.4.14, Proposition 3.5.1; support calculation also uses Stacks proetale.tex Tags 09AA, 09AH, 09BM, 09BN. Specialization of steps 1--5 of lem-sfb-supported-image-derived-completeness.

proof.text: Finite scalar local models L and M are derived complete, using the existing finite-model theorem and the canonical degree-zero localization isomorphism.

Choose the simultaneous strict completion presentations and section-action comparison. The principal-model comparison identifies the section unit complete locus. Naturality and the derived section equivalence make invertibility of the internal unit equivalent to invertibility of the principal unit on the section module in degree zero.

Apply complete_heart_kernels to the actual section-action map. Transport ordinary kernel and image through the exact equivalence using PreservesKernel.iso and PreservesImage.iso, then back through the complete-locus equivalence.
